captions.instagram:
Own a business that passes profit to your personal return? Look up the QBI deduction.

✔️ Up to 20% of qualified business income, generally, on Form 8995 or 8995-A.
✔️ For 2026, the simple form works if taxable income is at or below $201,750 (single) or $403,500 (married filing jointly). Above that, extra limits can apply.
✔️ New for 2026: a $400 minimum deduction if you have at least $1,000 of income from businesses you actively work in.
✔️ Wages from a job and an S corp owner's salary don't count as QBI.

Our Schedule C guide shows where it fits for single-member LLCs.
